test_title: PYST 85: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 05 Mar, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Five friends P, B, C, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre. B is sitting to the immediate left of C. G and H are not the immediate neighbour of C. H is sitting second to the right of P. Who is sitting on the immediate right of G?
solution:
Given: Five friends P, B, C, G and H.

1) B is sitting to the immediate left of C.

2) G and H are not the immediate neighbour of C.

3) H is sitting second to the right of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3cd00c5c96a5a5a373042b64404e36d69521a72e78e9bd15d2680502fb0cf47d.png] 

So, **H** is sitting on the immediate right of G.

Hence, the correct answer is **"H".**
